title: A tracked SEP-41 token that upgrades to a WASM whose transfer takes to: MuxedAddress is no longer indexed, and its old balances keep being served
severity_basis: matchSEP41Spec accepts a MuxedAddress recipient in transfer only when the parameter is named to_muxed, so a WASM with the standard transfer(from: Address, to: MuxedAddress, amount: i128) does not match. A tracked token that upgrades to it stops being indexed while its contract_tokens row stays sep41 and its sep41_balances rows stay as at the upgrade, and BalanceModel.GetByAccount keeps serving them as current: a silent stale balance, limited to the upgrading token's own balances (29 pubnet contracts in the issue), so medium, not high.

entries.expected: a WASM whose transfer is transfer(from: Address, to: MuxedAddress, amount: i128) matches SEP-41, so a tracked token keeps being indexed after it upgrades to it
entries.observed: No corpus entry holds such a WASM. By hand at 18db88f4: matchSEP41Spec gives false for transfer(from: Address, to: MuxedAddress, amount: i128) and true when only the parameter is renamed to_muxed; on pubnet it gives true for WASM 43a1cd08… and false for 07bab30e…, 87827804… and 72eb5d52…, which the 29 contracts of the issue upgraded to.

evidence.pre_fix: Executed by hand outside the kit's runs, with the reproduction in the upstream issue; no run of the kit compares this behaviour, so no report row exists. At wallet-backend 18db88f4, the issue's test (internal/services/sep41/muxed_transfer_test.go) prints matchSEP41Spec = false for transfer(from: Address, to: MuxedAddress, amount: i128) and true for the same signature with to_muxed. On a local network (stellar-core 30.0.0, live ingestion at the same code), a tracked SEP-41 token upgraded to a WASM with the same storage and events but a non-matching interface: a later transfer was not booked, the old row kept its value and contract_tokens.type stayed sep41.
evidence.expected_basis: SEP-41 and soroban-sdk's TokenInterface declare transfer(from: Address, to: MuxedAddress, amount: i128) (https://github.com/stellar/stellar-protocol/blob/master/ecosystem/sep-0041.md).

reproduction.method: The run the issue reports, made at 18db88f4 before filing on 2026-11-19: the test prints false for to: MuxedAddress and true for to_muxed: MuxedAddress.
